name: Tyrande Whisperwind
summary: Tyrande Whisperwind keeps watch over the night elves from Teldrassil. She is Elune’s High Priestess and the supreme leader of her people, who endured the War of the Ancients and the ten millennia of the Long Vigil under her guidance alongside Malfurion Stormrage. Now she commands the Sisterhood of Elune and directs the Sentinel army in Kalimdor’s defense.

sections.title: Chosen of the Moon Goddess
sections.body: Born in the ancient kaldorei empire, Tyrande grew up with the twin brothers Malfurion and Illidan Stormrage. The brothers turned to druidism and sorcery, while she became a priestess of Elune. When the Burning Legion first invaded Azeroth in the War of the Ancients, Tyrande stood against it beside Malfurion. The Moon Goddess granted her direct favor, and Tyrande shaped the Sisterhood into a fighting force. Her priestesses wielded divine healing and lunar wrath as the kaldorei faced annihilation.

sections.title: The Long Vigil and the Sentinels
sections.body: After the Great Sundering and the sealing of the Well of Eternity, Malfurion and the druids entered the Emerald Dream for long hibernations. Tyrande took on the lonely task of defending their recovering realm. She formed the Sentinels, an elite cadre of warrior-women who patrolled Kalimdor’s forests through ten thousand years. During the Long Vigil, they kept watch over ancient evils and lingering demonic remnants. Tyrande held to her faith in Elune while centuries passed between brief reunions with Malfurion.

sections.title: The Third War and a New Haven
sections.body: When the Burning Legion returned during the Third War, Tyrande woke the sleeping druids to face the danger. Though she mistrusted the newly arrived orcs and humans, she helped forge a desperate coalition at Mount Hyjal. The night elves gave up their immortality at Nordrassil to destroy Archimonde. Mount Hyjal now bears the scars of that battle, and Malfurion is again occupied with guarding the Emerald Dream. From the grand Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, Tyrande governs the kaldorei and watches for Horde incursions as her people take their place in the Alliance.

faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind is the High Priestess of Elune and the supreme spiritual and political leader of the night elves. For over ten thousand years, she has guided her people from the War of the Ancients through the Third War. She now leads the kaldorei from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Where does Tyrande reside right now?
faq.answer: Tyrande resides in Darnassus, high in the branches of Teldrassil. She presides from the upper sanctuary of the Temple of the Moon, among the Priestesses of Elune and Sentinel guards.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Tyrande and Malfurion?
faq.answer: Tyrande and Malfurion Stormrage are lifelong partners who have guided night elf civilization together for ten millennia. In their youth, Malfurion and his twin brother Illidan both sought her love. Tyrande chose Malfurion, whose devotion to balance and nature reflected her faith in Elune.

faq.q: What is the Sisterhood of Elune?
faq.answer: The Sisterhood of Elune is an ancient order of night elf priestesses devoted to the Moon Goddess. Under Tyrande, its members heal, serve as spiritual guides, and take fierce roles as martial commanders and combatants.

faq.q: What role did Tyrande play in the Long Vigil?
faq.answer: During the ten thousand years after the Sundering, while Malfurion and the male druids slept in the Emerald Dream, Tyrande established and commanded the Sentinels. She patrolled Kalimdor’s wilds, hunted remaining satyrs and demons, and kept her people safe in isolation.

faq.q: Why is Tyrande wary of the Horde?
faq.answer: Tyrande is wary of the Horde because orcs entered Ashenvale during the Third War, cut sacred forests, and slew the demigod Cenarius under the influence of demon blood. An uneasy truce was made at Mount Hyjal, but the Horde’s ongoing logging in Ashenvale keeps her Sentinels on high alert.

angles.text: As a night elf, Tyrande is your supreme leader and High Priestess. For over ten thousand years, she has kept vigil over your people and championed the light of Elune through every trial.
As a priest, see Tyrande as a living vessel of Elune’s divine favor. She embodies the height of kaldorei priesthood, calling down lunar stars and mending wounds through faith.
Though your people have long been reclusive and fiercely independent, Tyrande leads the night elves within the Alliance for mutual defense against Kalimdor’s growing perils.
As a druid, know that while Malfurion sleeps in the Emerald Dream, Tyrande works closely with the Cenarion Circle to protect sacred groves and nurture Teldrassil.
To the Horde, Tyrande is a formidable and uncompromising adversary. She has commanded the Sentinels to violently resist resource harvesting across Ashenvale.
